newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Military Bank raises deposit rates.
newsitem.headline: Thai Military Bank raises deposit rates.

text.p: Thai Military Bank Plc on Friday raised its deposit rates 25-100 basis points with immediate effect in a move to maintain its market share of domestic bank deposits.

"Some small and medium banks have raised their deposit rates, so we have to raise our rates to maintain our market share of about six percent of total domestic deposits," the bank said in a statement.
Thai Military Bank did not detail its current deposit rates but said they are 25-50 basis points higher than those offered by bigger Thai banks.
